notes.title: Game Update(2021.1.18)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39316548/deaa4af9ac15fd170706d92c282fe8c82aa10bd0.jpg

- New feature "High-Speed Mode": After finishing the game for the first time, players can choose High-Speed Mode when starting a new game. In High-Speed Mode, all previously viewed texts and stage performances will play much faster. This doesn't affect any contents that were not viewed before.
- Fixed some text errors.
- Fixed wrong language UI buttons.
- Fixed a bug that can crash the game.

We will bring more updates to improve Dice Rollers in the future.
Your comments are most precious to us, we appreciate your time and opinions.
We are an amateur two-men part-time team, our game might be small and simple but it's full of our love.
Thank you very much for your support and time!
